resources.title: Introduction to Ghidra — student guide
resources.learn: Import a binary, analyze it, navigate functions and references, rename findings, and compare decompiler output with disassembly. Read the basic analysis, navigation and decompiler sections first.
resources.offline: Save the guide with images before travel; confirm it opens offline. The exercises accept a program of your choice, so use the benign reverse-4 companion.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched course objectives, exercise guidance and project/navigation sections of the official student guide. Layout and startup instructions may differ from approved Ghidra 12.1.4. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: Ghidra quickstart & tutorial: Solving a simple crackme
resources.learn: See a complete small password-check investigation: import, analysis, decompiler, function signatures and window navigation.
resources.offline: Use an authorized YouTube offline download if available and check playback before boarding. Watch as a walkthrough; a third-party crackme download is optional, not needed for reading.

resources.title: Reversing and Cracking first simple Program — bin 0x05
resources.learn: Connect C control flow to GDB disassembly using a tiny license-check example; pair the video with its source and annotated disassembly in reverse-4.

resources.title: bin 0x05 companion: license-check source and GDB disassembly
resources.learn: Draw the branch graph on paper from gdb_disassembly, predict which branch each input takes, then compare with license_1.c. This works as a reading exercise without executing a downloaded binary.
resources.offline: Save gdb_disassembly and license_1.c before departure. Optional hands-on work requires a prepared local GDB/Ghidra environment; use the readable benign source, and check your compiled output because addresses will differ.

resources.title: capa usage: understand capability matches
resources.learn: Read default versus verbose output and rule filtering; use match locations as leads for investigation rather than treating a capability label as a complete explanation.
resources.offline: Save the usage page; inspect its printed examples on the plane. CLI reading needs no live malware. Skip cloud uploads, IDA/Binary Ninja backends and sandbox integration for this study path.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched usage documentation including default/-v/-vv behavior, tag filtering and supported integrations. Current master may exceed approved capa 9.4.0; confirm options locally before use. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: FLOSS usage: static, stack, tight and decoded strings
resources.learn: Learn why ordinary strings can miss useful values and how FLOSS groups extracted string types. Concentrate on default extraction and string-type selection.
resources.offline: Save the Markdown page before travel. Read the examples without executing sample malware; newer filtering/summary options need a local version check.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched upstream usage explanations and options. Workbook FLOSS version is not captured, so master-only options are not assumed available. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: Writing YARA rules
resources.learn: Learn strings and conditions, text versus hex patterns, wildcards and boolean combinations. Optional benign drill: draft a rule to distinguish two small text files you create.
resources.offline: Save the relevant sections as HTML/PDF; the benign text-file drill is local once YARA is available. No malware collection or network service is required.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched the official rule reference, examples, strings and hex wildcard sections. Read common YARA 4 syntax; installed workbook version is 4.5.8 and the stable docs may differ. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: dnSpyEx: managed assembly navigation and debugging capabilities
resources.learn: Identify the .NET workflow: find entry points, search strings/classes, follow callers, inspect IL, then use breakpoints and locals when appropriate. Start with navigation before editing assemblies.
resources.offline: Save README and relevant screenshots before travel. Practical debugging requires a prepared Windows environment and a benign assembly; no additional Unity setup is needed for this reading path.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched upstream README, debugger, assembly editor, hex editor and navigation features. This is a capability orientation, not a complete worked challenge. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: JADX: APK/DEX reading and decompiler limits
resources.learn: Learn the Android entry workflow: load APK/DEX, search Java-like output and resources, and treat failed or suspicious decompilation as a reason to inspect bytecode with the approved companion tools.
resources.offline: Save README before departure; prepare any benign APK locally. GUI/CLI use can be offline once Java and JADX are working. Do not assume cloud deobfuscation is permitted.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched upstream README and command options. Current README targets a moving release; approved JADX is 1.5.6. This is an orientation and reference, not a full Android challenge walkthrough. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.

resources.title: pyinstxtractor-ng: inspect and extract a PyInstaller executable
resources.learn: Separate packaging from bytecode recovery: extract a PyInstaller archive first, then identify bytecode version before selecting pycdc, uncompyle6 or unpyc3. Extraction alone does not recover Python source.
resources.offline: Save README before travel. Read its examples without executing extracted code; prepare a benign sample only if you want an offline drill. Do not use the linked web service for event files.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Exa fetched upstream README, supported ELF/PE containers, xdis-based version handling and CLI examples. Workbook version is unknown; check local help before relying on --info or other current options. Not watched or executed; study_minutes is a planning estimate, not video runtime.
